entries.definition: great coolness and composure under strain
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Adds balance and bearing to the coolness, praising how the strain is carried as much as the nerve behind it.

entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Informal and jaunty, its air of finishing a task neatly is exactly what makes it callous here.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Carries the treasuring force of *prize* exactly, under a different spelling.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The regard of someone who would not part with it; more possessive than *value*.

entries.definition: state of uncertainty or perplexity especially as requiring a choice between equally unfavorable options
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Softer than *dilemma*, dwelling on the wavering state of the person stuck rather than on how bad the options are.

entries.definition: a disposition free from stress or emotion
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The plainest of these: a temperament with no emotional weather in it, and none of the loftiness of *serenity*.

entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Informal, stating the faith as a settled count, plainer than *swear* and less deliberate than *calculate*.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The peak of the set, happiness raised to great intensity rather than left at an even glow.

entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Steady and unemphatic: confidence as a standing arrangement rather than the wager *bet* makes of it.

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Trust placed with assurance, active and chosen where *depend on* keeps the note of need.
examples: she is someone you can really rely on when times get rough
you can rely on his discretion

entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Formal beside *rely on*, the same confident placing of trust carried with a stiffer bearing.

entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The furthest euphemism in the set, rendering a premeditated killing as an act of tidying and hiding the intent inside the blandness.

entries.definition: a disposition free from stress or emotion
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The freedom from stress sounds like an ease rested in, warmer than the unstirred flatness of *placidity*.
